nodes.label: archive/ — nothing deleted, nothing read by any build
nodes.rationale: Superseded working documents are moved out of the build's way rather than pruned, so a stale document can never be mistaken for a live one and is still recoverable.

nodes.label: Transitions v3.0 — a separate line of work
nodes.rationale: Not part of The Method 1.6 and referenced by no compendium; parked in the archive so it is out of the build's way without being lost.
